title: Full-circle or nothing. No half-shipped features.

blocks.title: I think like a user.
blocks.description: I test for hesitation, confusion, and the moment someone almost gives up, not just whether the function returns the right value.

blocks.title: I take full ownership.
blocks.description: At LPS Health and UI Health I owned workflows that other people relied on. That changes how carefully you design, test, document, and ship.

blocks.title: Security baked in from line one.
blocks.description: Input validation, sanitization, RBAC, rate limiting, JWT, not sprinkled on at the end when someone files a bug report.

blocks.title: 1px off? I see it. I fix it.
blocks.description: Transitions, spacing, states, they all matter. This is not perfectionism. It is respect for the person on the other side of the screen.
